events.quote: The Third Amendment also increased our maximum consolidated leverage ratio to 5.25 to 1.00 for the first and second quarter of 2026, 5.00 to 1.00 for the third quarter of 2026, 4.00 to 1.00 for the fourth quarter of 2026 and 3.50 to 1.00 for 2027 and thereafter.

flags: The text contains two grids. Only grid (a), which applies during the Covenant Adjustment Period (8 levels), is in 'levels'. Grid (b) is left out because its ratio ranges overlap with grid (a)'s and one list can't hold both without overlap. Reviewer must read grid (b) separately.

Grid (b) applies from and after the end of the Covenant Adjustment Period (6 levels; ratio to 1.00; SOFR+ / Base Rate+ / Commitment Fee, all %): I >=3.25: 2.75/1.75/0.35; II >=2.50 and <3.25: 2.50/1.50/0.30; III >=1.75 and <2.50: 2.25/1.25/0.30; IV >=1.50 and <1.75: 2.00/1.00/0.25; V >=1.25 and <1.50: 1.75/0.75/0.20; VI <1.25: 1.25/0.25/0.20. In grid (b), Level I is written 'Greater than or equal to 3.25' without 'to 1.00'.
The 'Covenant Adjustment Period' definition is not in the text, so the date grid (a) gives way to grid (b) is unknown.
Until the first Calculation Date occurring after March 31, 2026, the margin is fixed at Pricing Level III of clause (a): SOFR + 2.75%, Base Rate + 1.75%, Commitment Fee 0.35%.
Ratios are written 'X to 1.00'. Bounds are recorded as the X number only.
Margin columns are headed 'SOFR +' and 'Base Rate +'. SOFR is mapped to term_sofr_spread, though the text does not say 'Term' SOFR. Percentages are per annum.
Late-delivery default is Pricing Level I of the applicable grid, which is the highest-priced level in each grid.

Retroactive true-up: if a financial statement or compliance certificate was inaccurate and a higher margin would have applied, the Borrower must pay the additional interest. This survives termination of the Commitments and repayment of the Obligations.

flags.note: Closing Date defined as the date of the Agreement; the A&R agreement is dated June 28, 2023, so the first test date was assumed to be 2023-09-30. Confirm.

The table mixes standard and relief levels. Standard schedule from 2026-03-31 was taken as 3.50 (from the proviso and the post-relief fallback); relief levels are placed in the Covenant Adjustment Period regime. Pre-amendment levels are not available in the text provided. Confirm.

flags.quote: the Leverage Increase Period triggered by the Accu-Fab Acquisition shall not be resumed if the Covenant Adjustment Period has ended pursuant to clause (b) of such definition
flags.note: Says an Accu-Fab Leverage Increase Period is 'triggered' but also that none can be triggered or in effect during the Covenant Adjustment Period. Unclear whether it counts toward the two-use limit or ever applies.

flags.quote: the maximum Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio shall not exceed 4.00 to 1.00 at any time
flags.note: The 4.00 ceiling applies to the Leverage Increase Period. It is unclear whether it also caps the Covenant Adjustment Period levels of 5.25 and 5.00; read literally it conflicts with them.

flags.quote: the Borrower shall not be permitted to carry forward any unused Capital Expenditure limit, if any, from the Fiscal Year ended December 31, 2025
flags.note: The capex covenant is first tested for the FY ending 2026-12-31; the first carry-forward is into FY2028, since the limit commences with FY2027 carry-forward. The carry forward amount is not a fixed number (equals unused prior-year limit), so it is modeled with effect 'other'.
